awards.title: Best Real World Impact
awards.description: Rumii was recognized for the project with the clearest and most credible path to solving a real problem for real people and I received $1000

posts.text: I’m excited to announce that I’ll be joining Shopify in Toronto as a Software Engineer Intern for Winter 2027! Thank you to my friends and family who continue to support me and thanks to Edna Delgado and Karim El-Husseiny for a smooth recruiting process!

I’m incredibly excited to announce that I’ll be joining Solink as a Software Engineer Intern! I’ve always been passionate about building scalable backend systems, and I can't wait to dive into the complex infrastructure challenges that the engineering team at Solink tackles every day. A huge thank you to everyone who has supported me along the way, and the Solink team for this amazing opportunity.

A few months ago, I started asking students a simple question: “What’s the worst roommate experience you’ve ever had?” I expected a few funny stories. Instead, I heard dozens of stories about leases ruined, friendships destroyed, and entire school years derailed because of bad roommate matches. That’s what led me to build Rumii. This weekend at the Canadian Tech Summit, Rumii won Best Real-World Impact, recognizing the project with the clearest path to solving a real problem for real people. It

I just launched Rumii. A few months ago it was just a summer project and an idea that wouldn’t leave my head. Today it’s a live product. What started as a simple concept turned into designing the entire experience, building the backend, wiring up authentication, handling deployments, fixing edge cases at 2am, and learning things I definitely did not plan to learn this summer. Had a great time presenting Rumii at Shopify Builder Sunday! Huge thanks to the Shopify team and everyone who took the time to give feedback and ask thoughtful questions. Really inspiring to be around so many builders.
